title: How repository source becomes a static Topocode site
summary: Follow repository files through scanning, graph composition, generated layout and site artifacts, and the validated static bundle.

anchors.pattern: return { graph, logicalArchitecture, diagnostics, metrics, authoritative };

sections.title: Repository source
sections.body: The scanner walks the repository root to collect the files that provide source evidence.

sections.title: Scanned graph
sections.body: Scanning returns the repository graph together with its logical architecture, diagnostics, metrics, and authority result.

sections.title: Composed graph
sections.body: Artifact generation applies the configured modules to the scanned graph before deriving downstream artifacts.

sections.title: Layout and site artifacts
sections.body: The composed graph is transformed into architecture and layout data, then serialized with the generated site payload.

sections.title: Static site bundle
sections.body: After bundle validation, the generated site directory is copied into a staged output for static hosting.
